$comment: Ratchet for `npm run check:docs-freshness`. maxStale is the number of docs allowed to be describing code that moved after they were written. It goes DOWN as docs are refreshed and never up without a reason recorded below, which is what stops drift from being permanently normal.

history.reason: Baseline. First measurement of the 467-doc corpus after the doc-to-code dependency graph landed.

Full sweep: all 55 stale docs re-verified against source; 47 corrected and recommitted, 8 remain measured-stale only because they were verified accurate without needing an edit (the tool's clock is the doc's last commit). 15 leaves headroom for normal weekly code churn between refresh passes.

Full sweep of the whole stale queue, 110 docs (109 ranked at the start, plus one that crossed the line during the pass): 82 corrected against the commits that drifted, 22 read and found already accurate, 6 classified as dated records. Review baselines landed in the same pass (data/docs-freshness-reviews.json), so a doc verified without an edit can now be recorded instead of staying measured-stale, which is what let this reach 0. The check is wired into `npm run gate` from here, so 5 is deliberate headroom for normal churn between passes rather than a backlog allowance: 367 docs sit in watch and a few cross the line most weeks.

Raised from 5 under work order 402 (restore a green gate): 30 docs were re-verified and committed (157 stale down to 127), but the corpus drifted well past the 2026-09-17 baseline after a month of fast shipping. 130 is the measured 127 plus 3 headroom. The remaining backlog is owned by order 403 (prompts/finish/403-auto-drain-docs-freshness.md), which ratchets this back down to 5.
Order 403 drain, batch 1: 12 docs reviewed against code (118 stale measured plus 3 headroom).

Full sweep of the whole stale queue, 158 docs (156 ranked at the start plus 2 that crossed the line during the pass): 123 corrected against the drifted commits, 21 read and found already accurate, 14 classified as dated records. 10 of the corrected docs stay measured-stale only because their edits name other crypto projects and are held for owner approval under the commit gate; once committed and stamped the measured count is 0, and this ratchets to 5.

Order 403 close-out: the 9 docs left stale (8 at the start of the pass plus STRUCTURE.md, which crossed the line during it) reviewed against their drifted commits and stamped (solana-rpc-lanes, skill-royalties, ux-flows/01 onboarding, event-readiness/04 multiplayer, ux-flows/12 home, crypto-api, ops/trading-bot-report, the IBM MCP post, STRUCTURE.md). Measured 0 stale; floor of 5 kept as headroom for routine drift.
